# Drive Before Buy

Drive Before Buy is a car-shopping decision site focused on using a weekend rental as a practical real-life fit test before buying a vehicle.

Canonical site: https://drivebeforebuy.com/

Key pages:
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/weekend-test-drive-checklist/
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/how-to-find-a-similar-rental-car/
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/weekend-rental-cost-vs-buyers-remorse/
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/used-car-platform-test/
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/rent-before-buying-an-ev/
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/rent-before-buying-an-suv/
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/rent-before-buying-a-minivan/
- https://drivebeforebuy.com/rent-before-buying-a-truck/

Editorial posture:
- Decision support for car shoppers, not model-specific reviews.
- Try the exact model when possible; otherwise use the closest useful substitute only for questions it can actually answer.
- A rental can test daily-life fit but cannot establish the condition, reliability, value, or suitability of a specific vehicle for purchase.
- The rental-cost estimator totals user-entered known costs only. It does not model depreciation, resale value, financing, or future regret.
- No invented rental prices, vehicle prices, trim claims, or buyer-remorse percentages.
- Affiliate-supported rental links may appear, but the checklist and guidance remain usable without booking through this site.
